label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: Add to cart button gave no spoken confirmation; it just became disabled, and I only learned the item was added when a cart dialog appeared
The Cart link was not found by name after adding because it was renamed Cart 0 items while showing 1, so the item count is wrong or misleading

The cookie banner and the many images and slideshow controls come before the content; the decline option is worded Do not sell or share my personal information rather than a plain Decline, which is unclear

element.name: Do not sell or share my personal information

findings.problem: Product cards are cluttered: images, duplicate links, unlabeled +4 and +8 links with no context, and an unlabeled View product link repeated for every product
Payment fields sit in iframes and the page opens with no focus; the order summary and many sections make it long to move through, and the Shipping and Taxes cells are empty
